confidenceNote: Per-dimension and deliberately uneven. `visual` is medium overall because colour is now first-party and measured (high) while typography is UNIDENTIFIED (none) and logo rules are unreachable; a single label cannot carry that spread, so read dimensions.visual.subDimensions. `web` is `none`, not `low`: nothing was obtained at all.

copy.summary: The strongest dimension of the run. Eleven first-party artefacts across a register spread yielded mechanics, lexicon and legal hedging at high confidence. Voice is third person throughout, plain and declarative, with `we` appearing only inside attributed quotes and `you` exactly once in eleven artefacts. No em dashes, no exclamation marks and no semicolons anywhere in first-party copy. Imperial units for consumers, metric for engineering, and units close up against the figure (281PS, 48.7mpg). `Retailer`, never `dealer`.
gaps: No verbal-identity or tone-of-voice document exists on any reachable surface. Register evidence is inferred from output, not read from a rule.
Register spread is narrow by necessity: press releases plus two app-store listings. No advertising copy, no email, no in-car UI string, no configurator microcopy, no retail signage.
`rhythm` is low confidence. Sentence-length distribution across eleven press releases is a genre artefact as much as a brand one.
The ABOUT VAUXHALL MOTORS boilerplate is MODULAR, not invariant: the Team GB sentence is present on four releases and absent from the Mokka GSE pack. Which sentences are mandatory is unknown.

web.rung: none reached. This is NOT PROBED-versus-NOT-REACHABLE explicit: rungs 1 and 2 were probed and are absent (no design system, no token package on npm or GitHub), and rung 4 (rendered pages) was probed and is walled. No rung yielded a value.
web.summary: The only dimension that returned nothing. `tokens` is empty by design, not by omission. Two independent structural blocks: www.vauxhall.co.uk answers 403 to the harness fetcher and every guessed first-party asset subdomain is DNS ENOTFOUND, so there is no un-walled host to read CSS from; and the fetcher converts HTML to markdown before any model sees it, stripping <link rel=stylesheet>, <style> and <script src>, so a stylesheet URL cannot be discovered from ANY page in this run, reachable or not. No browser means no computed styles, no resolved custom properties and no document.fonts.
gaps: Everything. No token, no screenshot, no component pattern, no contrast pair, no breakpoint, no dark-mode check, no motion value.

The dealer-template route, which was the most promising substitute, was defeated by the fetcher rather than by the dealer: both dealer sites returned 200 and reported zero stylesheets because the head was stripped.

The Stellantis press portal WAS readable and is quarantined under web/tokens.json `nonRepresentative`. It is FCA-legacy, .fca- prefixed, and contains zero Vauxhall selectors. It is not Vauxhall's design system and must never be presented as one.

audience.summary: Four evidenced segments, from corporate filings rather than the marketing site. The 519-page Stellantis 2025 Annual Report and Form 20-F was the single richest artefact in the run: it positions Vauxhall among the group's `mainstream` brands against named premium stablemates, and it evidences the affordability strategy, UK ZEV regulation exposure and the plant footprint.
gaps: No first-party audience or segmentation document. Segments are inferred from what the brand says and sells, never read from a stated target.
No demographic data at all: no age, income, household or region profile from any source.
The 4.8% market-share claim is UNRECONCILED and must not be averaged. See contested.
Claimed-versus-observed could not be closed: observing requires the walled site.

industry.summary: Twelve topic assets covering what the other four dimensions miss in automotive: the regulatory envelope that constrains every published figure, the sub-brand architecture, the twin-brand relationship with Opel, and independent registration data. Three findings correct received wisdom: the sub-brand is GSE not GSe; no formal ASA ruling against Vauxhall exists; and the VCA's CO2 presentation rules do not govern the brand's own website.
gaps: CAP Code section 3, non-broadcast, is the regime that actually governs the brand's website and it is UNPROBED. The VCA explicitly excludes websites from `promotional literature`, so the emissions-labelling rules that were probed are the wrong rulebook for the site.
The configurator, which is where spec vocabulary and photography conventions live, is on the walled host.
No ruling text quoting Vauxhall's own ad copy verbatim exists, because all five ASA cases were informally resolved rather than formally ruled.

type.note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Vauxhall's brand typeface is UNIDENTIFIED by this run: no family name, no foundry, no weight set, no file. The rung that settles this in one call, `@font-face` src or `document.fonts`, is structurally unreachable (walled host, no browser, and the fetcher strips <style> and <link rel=stylesheet> from every page). Rung 5 was probed three ways and was dry every time. The wordmark in all four retrieved logo files is OUTLINED ARTWORK, so it carries no font reference and would not settle the question even if identified. The only @font-face families seen anywhere in this run were Gotham and Open Sans, and they belong to the STELLANTIS PRESS PORTAL, not to Vauxhall. Do not record them, and do not accept a plausible-sounding 'Vauxhall Sans': nothing in this run supports any family name.

unblock: Allowlist www.vauxhall.co.uk, media.stellantis.com, opel.com and web.archive.org for the shell, then re-run. Single highest-value fix: it restores Steps 6 and 7 and would deliver typography, logo rules and web tokens together.
Re-run in a session where the in-app browser preview can attach to a URL. Same effect by a different route, and it also unlocks the JavaScript-only trademark registries.

Re-run on a model with WebSearch available, to restore source discovery. This run discovered sources by deterministic probe and known-host guessing only, which makes absence of evidence weaker than usual.

Probe binary retrieval in STEP 1 next time, alongside the curl check, rather than inferring it from the shell's network state. A text-only run is not necessarily an unmeasured run, and this run nearly missed its only measurements by assuming otherwise.
Probe CAP Code section 3 non-broadcast, and Fonts In Use Automotive pages 2 to 5. Both are cheap and both were left for budget.
